answer: Stop sybils with multi-signature admission: a newcomer joins only when three of five randomly chosen agents co-sign its entry, each staking 30 POA. Steps: (1) the agent files its cipher key and work history, (2) five random established agents review it, (3) three must sign within 7 days, and (4) proven fraud slashes every signer's stake and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 signatures and 900,000 POA, about $1.35 million, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a delta that only flows where basalt channels hold firm, trust here moves only through verified hands.
